## Change

Describe the code, content or governance change and the user impact.

## Evidence

- [ ] Quality gate passes.
- [ ] No sensitive lived-moment data is sent off device.
- [ ] Content identifiers and review dates remain valid.
- [ ] Accessibility impact checked.
- [ ] Monitoring contains no PII, query strings, fragments or session replay.

## Required approvals

- [ ] Technical review.
- [ ] Clinical review when moments, supports, scope or safety boundaries change.
- [ ] APD review when nutrition content or claims change.
- [ ] Privacy review when data, analytics, monitoring, consent or integrations change.
- [ ] First Nations governance review when cultural content, data or community claims change.

- Release record: `governance/releases/...`
